parsed.draft: Hi all, Kavitha Nair is excited about our Founding AI Engineer offer and will confirm by the twelfth once she has read the engagement documents. Those can only go once the board approves the ESOP pool — could we approve it in the next day or two? Arjun

next_move.what: Get the board's approval of the ESOP pool now, and send Kavitha the engagement documents the day it is given — in time for her to read them before the twelfth.

facts.claim: Arjun offered Kavitha Nair the Founding AI Engineer role at Nimbus Labs — the salary they discussed and ESOPs vesting over four years — subject to the board approving the ESOP pool.
The offer asked Kavitha to confirm her acceptance by the twelfth of August, and said the engagement documents will follow once the board approves.
Kavitha replied, in under two days, that she is excited and will confirm by the twelfth once she has read the documents.

inferences.claim: Her confirmation now hangs on documents that cannot go out before the board approves the ESOP pool, so the board's approval decides whether the twelfth holds.
Nothing more is owed by Kavitha until the documents reach her: the next step on this file is the company's.

patterns.claim: No hiring playbook is written for this file and none names a stop rule, so no usual course can be read off it; the only clock is the date in the offer.

hypotheses.proposition: The board's approval of the ESOP pool may already be in motion outside the mailbox.
hypotheses.needs: Arjun's word on whether the resolution is with the board, and when it will be passed.

hypotheses.proposition: Kavitha may want a word on the terms, beyond the documents, before she confirms.
hypotheses.needs: Her questions once the documents reach her.

unknowns.question: Has the board approved, or even been asked to approve, the ESOP pool?
unknowns.relevance: If the approval cannot land before the twelfth, the date has to move with Kavitha's agreement rather than lapse.

unknowns.question: Are the engagement documents drafted and ready to send the day the board approves?
unknowns.relevance: If not, drafting them is a second step between the board and Kavitha.

unknowns.question: Has Kavitha heard anything outside this mailbox — a call, a draft agreement?
unknowns.relevance: It changes what she still needs before she can confirm.

frames.primary: A founding hire who has said yes in spirit: Kavitha will confirm once she has read the engagement documents, and those wait on the board approving the ESOP pool — the next step is the company's, not hers.
rivals: A plain wait on the candidate: her answer is due by the twelfth and nothing is needed from the founder until then.
An offer drifting into risk: if the pool is not approved in time, the documents and her acceptance both slip, and a warm hire cools.

expected_vs_actual.expected: From the brief's goal of hiring a Founding AI Engineer and the offer itself: the board approves the ESOP pool, the engagement documents reach Kavitha, and she confirms by the twelfth of August.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Kavitha replied warmly that she will confirm by the twelfth once she has read the documents; nothing in the file shows the board's approval or the documents going to her.

scenarios.do_nothing: The twelfth comes with no documents in Kavitha's hands, she cannot confirm as she said she would, and the offer's date passes on the company's delay, not hers.
scenarios.act: Getting the board's approval now lets the documents reach Kavitha with time to read them, so her confirmation can land by the twelfth.
scenarios.best: The board approves at once, the documents go out, and Kavitha confirms in writing by the twelfth.
scenarios.worst: The approval stalls, the date passes in silence, and a founding hire who was excited cools or accepts another offer.
signals_to_watch: The board's approval of the ESOP pool on record
The engagement documents sent to Kavitha
Kavitha writing again before the twelfth — with questions, or to ask for time

reasons: Hiring a Founding AI Engineer is one of the goals the brief names.
Her confirmation waits on the documents, and the documents wait on the board, against the twelfth of August.
A founding hire lost to delay, or an acceptance given on a pool the board has not approved, is costly to undo.

parsed.alternative: If the board cannot approve in time, write to Kavitha before the twelfth, tell her the documents follow the board's approval, and agree a new date for her confirmation.
parsed.wait_or_stop: Once the documents are with her, wait for her confirmation until the twelfth; if the board has not approved by then, stop waiting on it and move the date with Kavitha in writing.
parsed.done_when: The ESOP pool is approved, Kavitha has the engagement documents, and her acceptance is in writing.
